entry_surfaces./: editorial asymmetric hero with kinetic scripture line-reveal and high-impact live worship image right, bento schedule below
entry_surfaces./tentang: split narrative layout — church history & pastoral vision left, core values bento grid right
entry_surfaces./jadwal: bento grid of weekly and Sunday service streams with interactive countdown and filter tabs
entry_surfaces./pelayanan: asymmetric multi-column commissions directory with interactive cards (Youth, Teens, Kids, Adults, Music, Diakonia)
entry_surfaces./pokok-doa: intimate prayer portal with warm terracotta form left and anonymous encouragement prayer feed right
entry_surfaces./kritik-saran: aspirasi jemaat submission surface with structured feedback categories and pastorate transparency note
entry_surfaces./formulir: filterable repository of official church administrative forms with direct PDF/doc download triggers
entry_surfaces./pujian: searchable Indonesian church songbook and lyrics repository with PDF sheet music & chord chart downloads
entry_surfaces./warta-jemaat: chronological digital bulletin rack with instant PDF viewer trigger, archive search, and weekly highlights
entry_surfaces./kontak: interactive location map card with Kediri church address, WhatsApp hotline, pastoral office hours, and social channels
entry_surfaces./admin: high-density tactical management console with prayer requests approval queue, warta uploader, formulir manager, and stats
entry_surfaces./login: branded split login — church positioning and pastoral emblem left, admin authentication form right

layout_strategy.grid_system: Bento Tetris Grid Mode A: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 with deliberate asymmetry and organic rounded-2xl containers
layout_strategy.spacing_scale: p-6 sm:p-8 lg:p-12 with generous section padding py-16 sm:py-24
layout_strategy.borders: 1px solid rgba(43, 30, 22, 0.08) with smooth hover shadow-md transitions

motion_and_interactions.kinetic_hero: Staggered word & line mask reveals using motion/react variants for the main header (Gereja yang Mengasihi & Bertumbuh Bersama)
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon displaying weekly memory verse (Ayat Minggu Ini), theme year, and upcoming service countdown
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Smooth lift hover states on bento cards (-translate-y-1), soft badge pulse, active tab underline slider
motion_and_interactions.scroll_experience: Natural responsive momentum scroll, sticky crystal header with glassmorphism blur and saturation boost

accessibility_and_locale.locale: id-ID (Bahasa Indonesia throughout: Hari Minggu, Ibadah Raya, Warta Jemaat, Komisi Pemuda, Persekutuan Doa)
accessibility_and_locale.contrast_compliance: All surface text meets minimum 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG AA contrast against respective solid/scrim backgrounds
accessibility_and_locale.testing_attributes: Strict requirement: every interactive button, input, tab, download link, and modal trigger must carry role-based data-testid (e.g. data-testid="submit-pokok-doa-btn", data-testid="download-warta-item-1")

instructions_to_main_agent: Theme: Implement warm organic chocolate (#2B1E16, #FAF7F2, #EADECF) paired with fresh youth sage green (#5B7C5B, #E5EDE5) — youthful, clean, editorial, NOT a corporate template.

Indonesian Language: Ensure all church terms are authentic Indonesian (e.g., Ibadah Raya 1 & 2, Kebaktian Remaja/Pemuda 'Youth Church', Sekolah Minggu 'Kids', Komisi Usia Indah 'Senior', Warta Jemaat, Pokok Doa, Pujian & Penyembahan).

Features Implementation: Build full reactive frontend forms with mock/real backend endpoints for (1) Pokok Doa (with toggle anonim/publik), (2) Kritik & Saran, (3) Formulir download with search & category filters, (4) Songbook Pujian with chord toggle / lyrics preview / download, (5) Warta Jemaat with PDF download & issue viewer, (6) Admin Dashboard with tabbed management for all entities.
Typography: Import @fontsource-variable/lora for elegant editorial titles and @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans for readable, modern body copy in index.css.
Ensure every form and button includes data-testid attributes for testing verification.
